input: Write a short play for my nephew's school performance

gold.taskTitle: Write a Short Play for Nephew's School Performance
gold.taskDescription: Write an original short play suitable for a nephew's school performance.

questions.title: What age group are the student performers?
questions.description: Understanding the performers' ages shapes vocabulary, complexity, and content appropriateness.

questions.title: What is the theme or subject of the play?
questions.description: Knowing the theme or topic guides the story, tone, and characters.

questions.title: How many students need speaking roles?
questions.description: The number of cast members determines how many characters and lines to write.

questions.title: How long should the performance run in minutes?
questions.description: A target runtime determines the script length and scene count.

questions.title: Is this tied to a specific school subject or curriculum?
questions.description: Some performances are linked to history, literature, science, or a cultural event.

questions.title: What is the deadline for having the script ready?
questions.description: Knowing the due date sets the urgency and drafting schedule.

questions.title: Are there any props, costumes, or staging limitations to consider?
questions.description: Production constraints affect what scenes and settings are practical to write.
